ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Schtasks Schedule Types
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects scheduled task creations or modification on a suspicious schedule type

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ONLOGON\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ONSTART\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ONCE\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ONIDLE\\ .*"))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*NT\\ AUT.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ SYSTEM.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HIGHEST.*")))
